thread:
jen: opened PR 539 to condense the compact metrics quickstart into a single-page example. main asks: Go SDK snippet, tiny cost/latency table, and a note about batching SLOs. also link checker flagged a few dead links.

matt: +1. @alina can you author the Go snippet? keep it short and show trace attach + cost tags.

alina: I can do 8-10 lines. prefer minimal YAML for the dashboard example so readers can copy-paste. will mimic the Python snippet semantics.

jen: minimal YAML + an expandable "expanded example" section would be nice for advanced users. include a short table showing p50/p95 cost per 1k tokens.

sam: heads-up: metric naming changed in Console v2. update `latency_p50` -> `redwood.request.latency.p50` in the dashboard yaml and examples, otherwise dashboards will 404. added a small patch in my branch.

docs-bot: lint: docs/quickstart/compact_metrics.md: broken link https://old.link/tracehook -> 404; docs/quickstart/images/old-heatmap.png -> 404

dina: I'll run a link sweep and add redirects. can we add a CI smoke test that validates frontmatter links return 200?

jen: yes, I'll add a simple smoke test in the docs CI job that fetches each frontmatter link and errors on non-200. keeps tests cheap.

matt: for the Go snippet, include a short comment about batching parameter MaxBatchTokens and how it trades latency for cost. e.g. max tokens = 1024 lowers cost but may increase p95.

alina: draft snippet I pushed to my branch:
```go
client := redwood.NewClient(os.Getenv("REDWOOD_KEY"))
ctx := client.NewTraceContext("compact-quickstart") // attach trace for dashboard mapping
ctx.SetTag("cost_center", "playground")
// Note: tune MaxBatchTokens to trade latency vs cost; smaller values reduce p95
resp, _ := client.Dashboards().Render(ctx, "compact-dashboard")
fmt.Println(resp.ShareURL)
```

matt: looks good. add a short inline code comment showing how to set MaxBatchTokens in the client config.

alina: added a one-liner comment, will push in 20m.

jen: timeline: trying to merge today so the site build picks this up for tomorrow's release. please post any blockers.

sam: updated dashboard YAML and left a note about the metric rename in CHANGELOG.md.

dina: redirects created for the bad links, will post canonical URLs in the PR.

jen: thanks everyone. I'll request reviews after the Go snippet lands. :rocket:
